text: While this may have credence in a sedentary population, it does not necessarily hold true during resistance training, in which values can vary widely. Moreover, validity of the technique is predicated on accurate urine collection over the entire study period as well as stable maintenance of dietary protein intake, which can be challenging under free-living situations.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
chapter: Chapter 3: The Measurement of Muscle Hypertrophy
